name: QIDI Box
description: Tracks filament per QIDI Box slot on Moonraker printers such as the Q2. Charges each spool for what its slot used, and sets a slot's colour and filament on the printer when you assign a spool. Nothing is installed on the printer.
author: Luca-Bachini-Barr

moonraker_url.title: Moonraker URL
moonraker_url.description: Base URL of Moonraker, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7125

api_key.title: Moonraker API Key
api_key.description: Only needed if your Moonraker requires one

update_printer_slots.title: Set slot filament on the printer
update_printer_slots.description: When you assign a spool to a slot, set that slot's colour and filament on the printer to match
